scope: Expanded prepared owner through portable shell and actual ATL native-backed facade isolation; no production Rust owner switch or full renderer parity.

limits: prepared records only: native acceptance and text/style/WebVTT preprocessing bypassed
clear/copy covers entries and segments only; styles/metadata lifecycle excluded
rename loop only on NUL-free style names: native style-map ordering/duplicate naming and embedded-NUL comparison excluded
callback counts observed only; reentry, callbacks copying full host state excluded
queries use integer TIME mode only, no frame/FPS conversion claim
replay transport is bounded to 4096 records per control operation
native qsort/llround retained: only ordering/time handoffs are Rust-owned; portable value shells approximate CString/ATL storage and layout
no allocation failures, production native integration or rendering
TIME mode fixed; native non-Rust search branch only; trace logging disabled
minimal class shell, not renderer/host integration or complete class ABI
no allocation-failure or reentrant/concurrent mutation equivalence
schedule loops modeled from renderer; full GetSubtitle/ParseEffect not executed

i686-pc-windows-msvc.verification: Pinned/candidate sources checked against Git allowing checkout CRLF; all retained document traces/inputs/generated header and facade source/header/executable/repeated traces independently rehashed. Owner binaries reported hashes only (temporary native binary not retained).
